rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Following <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> and <color(4)>Norb<ce()>'s words, we have come all the way to the moon.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>We will now head to the microwave transmission facility on the lunar surface, and make contact with <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()><thumbnail(280)>.
rows.notes: 'microwave facility' matches D.O.M.E.'s role text in character_names_021.json.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Now, 15 years after the 7th Space War... the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> and the <book(42)>Space Rev. Army<endbook()> have plunged into an all-out clash.
rows.notes: '7th Space War' and '15 years' match released usage (batch_01346.json, encyclopedia_022.json). Compressed 'full-scale armed clash' to 'an all-out clash' to stay well under the 128-char limit.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Their goal is also <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()> We must make contact with <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()> before they do.
rows.notes: 'goal' for mokuteki avoids the letter j (objective).

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>We do not know what <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()> truly is. But it should hold one answer we are looking for.
<operator(30070,1)><speed(2)>In that dream, <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()> said it would tell me this world's secret.
<operator(30070,1)><speed(2)>Whether that is the same as what <color(4)>Norb<ce()><thumbnail(275)> teaches, I do not know.
<operator(30070,1)><speed(2)>But going to <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()> should let us take a big step toward dialogue with the <book(69)>Scub<endbook()> too.
rows.notes: book(69) rendered short 'Scub' (not 'Scub Coral') because the source itself abbreviates to スカブ here, matching dialogue/batch_05943.json's convention for the same short form.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>To <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()><thumbnail(281)>, <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> and I will go. Everyone, I am counting on you.
rows.notes: Reordered to keep D.O.M.E. before Tiffa, matching source tag order.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>One last thing to add: we have one more goal besides <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()>
<thumbdown()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>That goal is to survive. If you die, you lose - do not forget it!
<topic()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Starting with this battle, I will pilot the <color(4)>Terminus type303<ce()><thumbnail(282)>.
rows.notes: 'Terminus type303' by analogy with unit_names_014_b.json's 'Terminus typeB303' / 'Terminus typeR909' (source has no letter suffix here, unlike those two); no exact prior lock found for the plain 'type303' form.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>This unit is a heavy load on its pilot, but I can't be worrying about that. ...I will fight it through, no matter what.

uncertainties.issue: 'Terminus type303' has no exact prior lock (unit_names_014_b.json only has the letter-suffixed 'Terminus typeB303' / 'Terminus typeR909' forms and the bare 'Terminus 303'); rendered by the same pattern. Flag for a unit-name script pass if the letterless form later gets its own locked entry.
